name: Akarui Yoru no Planetarium
original_name: 明るい夜のプラネタリウム
source:
Our protagonist is a girl who loves the stars. Together with Peace, a boy from the world of stars, she lives in a city where the stars are invisible.

She has a dream.

"I want to open a planetarium, so that people in this starless city can see the stars anytime they want."

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17959]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我们的主角是一位热爱星星的女孩。她与来自星星世界的男孩Peace一起生活在一座看不见星星的城市里。

她有一个梦想。

“我想开一个天文馆，让这座没有星星的城市里的人们随时都能看到星星。”

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17959]Freem![/url]]
